rows.text: Sauron turns "the Ring tempts you" into a free wheel: discard your hand, draw four. In almost any other deck that is a cost. Here it is the point — the cards you throw away are seven-drops you were never going to cast, and the graveyard is where this deck keeps its best creatures. Every temptation is card advantage AND a loaded graveyard at the same time.

rows.name: Sauron, the Dark Lord
rows.text: a 7/6 with a ward that eats a legendary permanent, an Orc Army that grows every time an opponent casts anything, and — the important line — discard your hand and draw four whenever the Ring tempts you.

rows.name: Call of the Ring
rows.text: tempts you at the beginning of EVERY upkeep. With Sauron out that is a free wheel each turn, and it draws an extra card when you name a Ring-bearer.

rows.name: Ringsight
rows.text: tempts you and tutors any card sharing a colour with a legend you control.

rows.name: Sauron's Ransom
rows.text: tempts you, and either pile is fine — cards in hand are cards, cards in the graveyard are reanimation targets.

rows.name: Orcish Bowmasters
rows.text: amasses alongside Sauron's own Orcs, and punishes every extra card the table draws.
The Army is a real clock. Once it connects, Sauron tempts you again, which wheels you again.

rows.name: Entomb
rows.text: one mana, instant speed, exactly the creature you want.

rows.name: Buried Alive
rows.text: three at once.

rows.name: Careful Study
rows.text: two down for one mana.

rows.name: Faithless Looting
rows.text: the same, twice with flashback.

rows.name: Frantic Search
rows.text: free, and it untaps three lands.

rows.name: Ledger Shredder
rows.text: connives on everyone's second spell each turn, filtering constantly.

rows.name: Grave Researcher
rows.text: surveils every upkeep and prepares a free Reanimate once three creatures are down there.

rows.name: Archfiend of Ifnir
rows.text: every discard puts a -1/-1 counter on each of their creatures. Discarding a full hand to Sauron's trigger is a one-sided board wipe.

rows.name: Monument to Endurance
rows.text: every discard becomes a card, a Treasure or three life from each opponent. On a wheel turn it is all three.

rows.name: Reanimate
rows.text: one mana, any graveyard.

rows.name: Animate Dead
rows.text: two, and it works on theirs.

rows.name: Dance of the Dead
rows.text: the third copy, and the untap clause rarely matters.

rows.name: Necromancy
rows.text: flash speed, so you can reanimate at the end of their turn or in response to a wrath.

rows.name: Persist
rows.text: two mana for any nonlegendary creature.

rows.name: Chainer, Nightmare Adept
rows.text: discard a card to cast a creature from your graveyard each turn, and anything not cast from hand gets haste.

rows.name: Living Death
rows.text: your graveyard is deliberately the deepest at the table.

rows.name: Ancient Brass Dragon
rows.text: on connection, reanimate creatures with total mana value up to a d20 roll, from ANY graveyard.

rows.name: Anger
rows.text: sitting in the graveyard with a Mountain out, everything you reanimate has haste.

rows.name: Archon of Cruelty
rows.text: the best target. On entry and on every attack, an opponent sacrifices, discards and loses three while you draw and gain three.

rows.name: Burning-Rune Demon
rows.text: a two-card tutor where the "wrong" one goes to your graveyard, which is exactly where you want it.

rows.name: Marang River Regent
rows.text: a 6/7 flier that bounces two of their permanents, and an Omen half that draws three when you would rather have cards.

rows.name: Smaug, Wicked Worm
rows.text: Treasures scaled to their artifact count, and a card every time you spend Treasure mana.

rows.name: Archfiend of Ifnir
rows.text: a 5/4 flier that turns your own wheels into sweepers.

rows.name: Mana Drain
rows.text: counter, and the mana casts a reanimation spell.

rows.name: Counterspell
rows.text: the clean two-mana answer.

rows.name: Arcane Denial
rows.text: cheap, and the cards they get arrive too late.

rows.name: An Offer You Can't Refuse
rows.text: one mana for anything noncreature.

rows.name: Deadly Rollick
rows.text: free with your commander out.

rows.name: Deflecting Swat
rows.text: free, and it redirects the removal aimed at Sauron.

rows.name: Bitter Triumph
rows.text: a creature or planeswalker, and the discard cost is upside here.

rows.name: Feed the Swarm
rows.text: the only clean enchantment answer in Grixis.

rows.name: Chaos Warp
rows.text: the second one, and it covers planeswalkers.

rows.name: Blasphemous Act
rows.text: cheap, and your best creatures are in the graveyard where a wrath cannot reach them.

rows.name: Cyclonic Rift
rows.text: overloaded, the clear for a lethal reanimated board.

rows.name: Dauthi Voidwalker
rows.text: unblockable, blanks their graveyards, and steals their best card.

rows.name: Chandra's Ignition
rows.text: point it at Archon of Cruelty or Sauron. Six or seven damage to every other creature on the board and to each opponent, all at once.

rows.name: Shadowspear
rows.text: trample and lifelink on a fatty, and it strips indestructible and hexproof from their blockers.

rows.name: Lightning Greaves
rows.text: haste for the thing you just reanimated, and shroud on Sauron.

rows.name: Living Death
rows.text: after a couple of wheels, this is usually lethal on the spot.

rows.name: Rhystic Study
rows.text: their turns pay for yours.

rows.name: Mystic Remora
rows.text: the best card in the deck on turns one through four.

rows.name: Black Market Connections
rows.text: three effects a turn, and this deck's life total is not its bottleneck.

rows.name: Relic of Sauron
rows.text: two coloured mana and a repeatable loot.

rows.name: Fellwar Stone
rows.text: usually taps for exactly the pip you need.

rows.name: Arcane Signet
rows.text: the same.

guide.title: What to keep in an opening hand

rows.text: Keep an enabler and a reanimation spell. Entomb plus Reanimate with two lands beats any hand with an Archon of Cruelty in it, because the Archon is better in your graveyard than in your hand.
Do not be precious about your hand. Sauron's wheel discards everything — so cast what matters first, then take the temptation. Cards you were holding "just in case" become Reanimate targets.

rows.name: Call of the Ring
rows.text: two mana, and with Sauron out it is a wheel every single upkeep. Prioritise it over almost any single fatty.

rows.name: Sauron, the Dark Lord
rows.text: his ward costs you a legendary permanent, which is real. Lightning Greaves is often the better protection, because it means they cannot target him at all.
